slides.text: Most people do not lack boundaries. They lack words ready to use.
Saying no at work: "I can do this by Friday, or that by Monday. Which matters more?"
Declining a meeting: "I will not be able to attend. Could you send notes or the key decision?"
After hours: "I will pick this up first thing tomorrow."
Say it once, calmly, without a long apology. Over-explaining invites negotiation.
Prepare your script before you need it. Practice makes it feel natural.
Save this for the next time you need it.
